The MIP8 strategy family

Three rules-based monthly momentum strategies for Indian stocks, built on one shared discipline: own the market's strongest companies, let winners run, and stop new buying when the broad market weakens. Each strategy has its own page, compared with the market; all three are compared side by side below.

Strategy · MIP8-Sec6

Own the leaders. Sit out the storms.

Each month it owns a concentrated basket of the market's strongest companies, lets the winners run, and stops putting new money to work when the broad market turns weak.

3AK-CWORKS Platform tour

See the whole market. Act on evidence.

3AK-Cworks is a fully autonomous, systematic wealth-management system. Every evening it ingests the full NSE market, rebuilds its own sector and industry indices, measures market breadth from every angle, and turns it all into decisions that the strategies, including the MIP8 momentum family, execute by rule.

2,566NSE stocks tracked daily
15 yrsof exchange history, incl. delisted stocks
198synthetic sector, group and industry indices
170+market-breadth measures every session
3intelligence engines: market, sector, stock
Dailyautomated data-to-decision run after every close
3AK-Cworks · Cockpit, the evening read
How it is organised

One top-down path, from the whole market to a single order

Step 1 · Market

Is it a good time to be invested?

Breadth, regime and market intelligence decide how much risk to take.

Step 2 · Sectors

Where is the money going?

Synthetic sector and industry indices show leadership and rotation.

Step 3 · Stocks

Which names are leading?

Super charts, multi-stock grids, scans and stock intelligence.

Step 4 · Strategy

Execute without emotion

Rules turn the evidence into orders, placed and monitored automatically.

Step 1 · Market

Market breadth and intelligence, measured not guessed

An index can rise while most stocks fall. 3AK-Cworks reads what is happening underneath the index, every session, across the entire market.

Reports · Breadth
Detailed reporting

Breadth dashboard

The index chart, with its market regime shaded in, sits above the breadth that drives it.

  • Share of stocks above key moving averages, advancers vs decliners, turnover and volume
  • Plain-English reading of what the market is doing and what a trader should do about it
  • Filters for F&O, price, market cap, sector and price band
Reports · Market Breadth Monitor
Breadth intelligence

Market Breadth Monitor

A day-by-day table of breadth measures with a market stance on top. Each reading comes with the evidence behind it.

  • Exposure dial from 1 (sit out) to 5 (go big), backed by 15 years of history
  • 4% movers, breakouts vs breakdowns, 52-week highs and lows, MA breadth, breadth thrusts
  • Each cell coloured by how unusual it is, so the eye goes straight to what changed
Reports · Breadth charts

Breadth charts

Every breadth measure as its own chart, with the index overlaid. Stack any measures into a custom view with a synced crosshair to see how they line up over time.

Reports · Market Intelligence

Market Intelligence

Nine engines score buying pressure, selling pressure, leadership, money flow, volatility and more. It also finds the most similar markets in 14 years of history and shows what happened next.

Step 2 · Sectors & industries

Our own sector and industry indices, built from the ground up

Exchange sector indices are few and dominated by large companies. 3AK-Cworks classifies every stock at three levels (22 sectors, 58 industry groups, 187 industries) and builds its own equal-weighted index for every group with at least five members: 198 indices in all.

Sectors · Charts
Synthesised indices

Sector charts

Every sector on one screen, ranked by any measure. Click a sector to open its industry groups, then its industries, then the stocks inside.

  • Sector → industry group → industry → stock, in four clicks
  • Relative strength, moving averages and candles on every card
Sectors · Reports
Detailed reporting

Sector reports

Around 40 measures across every sector, group and industry, day by day: returns, power days, breadth, turnover, delivery and volatility.

  • Colours flag a reading that is unusual for that sector, not just large
  • Delivery value and turnover averages show where real money is committing
Sectors · Rotation

Rotation

A rotation map shows every sector's strength and momentum against the market. You can see leadership arriving before it is obvious on a price chart.

Sectors · Intelligence

Sector Intelligence

Each group gets a verdict: accumulate, strong, extended, exhausting or cooling. Rankings are tuned to swing, positional or investor horizons, and every signal shows its own historical hit rate.

Step 3 · Stocks

From one super chart to the whole industry at a glance

Every stock carries 43 daily metrics. The stock workspace lets you study one name in depth, compare a whole industry side by side, or search the market for a pattern.

Charts · Super chart
Super charts

One chart, every lens

A full charting workspace built for Indian markets.

  • Daily, weekly and monthly views side by side
  • Delivery %, relative strength vs index, sector and industry, RSI bands, base boxes
  • Circuit band and F&O status at a glance; colour-labelled watchlists with keyboard navigation
Stocks · Charts
Many stocks together

Multi-stock charts

Pick an industry and see its sector index, its industry index and every member stock in one grid. Switch to a list for returns, relative strength, turnover and delivery.

  • Sort the grid by any of dozens of metrics
  • Filter out circuit-band, illiquid or tiny stocks with one saved setting
Stocks · Heatmap

Stock heatmap

The market's most active names across recent sessions, by turnover, power days, price change, RSI or distance from moving averages.

Stocks · Lookup

Stock lookup

One stock in depth: 36 metrics across recent sessions, its sector and industry context, relative-strength ranks and momentum lifecycle.

Stocks · Scan Builder

Scan Builder

Build a scan from any combination of indicators, run it on today or any past date, save it as a template, and open the results straight into the multi-stock charts.

Stocks · Intelligence

Stock Intelligence

Combines the market, sector and stock views into scores for swing and positional horizons. It also flags an institutional delivery footprint, and every signal shows its measured base rate.

Step 4 · Strategy & execution

The part investors never see, and the part that matters most

The screens are for people. Underneath, the same data drives strategies that run themselves.

Clean data, every evening

An automated pipeline refreshes prices, indicators, delivery, circuit bands, F&O membership and classifications after every close. Point-in-time circuit-band and F&O history keeps backtests honest about what was knowable on the day.

Research with a high bar

Ideas must hold up on 15 years of exchange data, including delisted companies, and after costs and tax, before any capital touches them. Most ideas fail that bar, and that is the point.

Hands-off execution

Strategies place, track and reconcile their own orders through the broker, with health checks, alerts and an audit trail on every step. No emotional overrides.

The approach

Four rules of conduct, no discretion

Buy strength

Each month the strategy screens the whole NSE universe and owns the companies showing the strongest, steadiest price leadership.

Let winners compound

Positions are held for as long as they stay among the leaders, often for many months. Laggards are replaced, not averaged down.

Respect the market

A market-trend safeguard halts new buying when conditions weaken, so cash builds up naturally in bad phases.

Stay investable

Sector-concentration limits and liquidity filters keep the basket diversified and tradeable at size.

Track record

Two independent tests, one consistent story

A 14-year simulation on official NSE bhavcopy data, and a separate 2021–2026 study on a different dataset. Both start from ₹10 lakh and pay full trading costs on every trade.

What to expect

The ride is bumpy. The direction has been up.

~1 in 2

Trades that make money. The average winner gained +43% and the average loser lost −15%, so every ₹1 lost was matched by about ₹2.2 of gains.

5 of 14

Full years that ended negative in the 14-year test, the worst being 2016 at −23.8%. Expect a fall of 30% or more from a peak at some point.

91 days

Median holding period, with about 42 trades a year. Low turnover keeps costs and the tax bill manageable for a momentum strategy.

About these numbers. The performance figures come from thorough backtesting on clean exchange data (the 14-year test includes companies that later delisted) and from the MIP8-Sec6 Model Portfolio, which applies the same rules to 2026 market data from a ₹10 lakh start. They are historical results and cannot guarantee future returns.

The market is supreme. The strategy adapts to the market, holding back new buying and building cash when conditions weaken. In a prolonged weak market it cannot manufacture returns, as 2022 and 2025 show.

Costs and taxes. Returns are net of STT, brokerage, exchange and SEBI fees, GST, stamp duty and slippage (0.27% per side). "Pre-tax" is before capital-gains tax. "Post-tax" applies Indian short-term capital-gains tax to each financial year's realised gains for the strategy, and long-term capital-gains tax at exit for a buy-and-hold investment in each index. Indices are price indices and exclude dividends. Actual results will vary with entry date, execution prices and portfolio size.

Equity investments carry risk, including loss of capital. This document is for information only and is not an offer or investment advice. Data to 30 September 2026.

The approach

Same discipline, one change

Buy strength

Each month the strategy ranks the NSE universe on the strength and steadiness of its price leadership.

New money goes to challengers

New buying favours emerging leaders over the market's largest companies. A holding is never sold for growing large: a winner keeps its place.

Let winners compound

Positions are held for as long as they stay among the leaders, often for many months. Laggards are replaced, not averaged down.

Respect the market

A market-trend safeguard halts new buying when conditions weaken, so cash builds up naturally in bad phases and earns a liquid-fund yield.

Track record

Two independent tests, one consistent story

Why it works

The edge is in where new money goes

A momentum strategy already leans towards mid and small companies. MIP8-XL100 makes that explicit for new purchases only, and keeps every position it already owns.

Size, not luck

Leaving out a random set of companies instead of the largest makes no difference to the result. The gain comes from where new money goes, not from a smaller list.

Winners stay

The opposite rule, selling holdings once they become large, was tested and cost return: it cuts the very winners that grow into large companies.

What to expect

A momentum strategy, with the same bumps

~1 in 2

Trades that make money (51%). The average winner gained +41% and the average loser lost −14%.

30%+

About these numbers. The performance figures come from backtesting on clean exchange data (the 14-year test includes companies that later delisted) and from the MIP8-XL100 Model Portfolio, which applies the same rules to 2026 market data from a ₹10 lakh start. They are historical simulation results and cannot guarantee future returns.

The market is supreme. The strategy adapts to the market, holding back new stock buying and building cash when conditions weaken. In a prolonged weak market it cannot manufacture returns.

Costs and taxes. Returns are net of STT, brokerage, exchange and SEBI fees, GST, stamp duty and slippage (0.27% per side), and include about 6% a year on idle cash in a liquid-fund ETF. "Post-tax" applies Indian capital-gains tax to each financial year's realised gains: 20% short-term on equity (15% before July 2024), the slab rate on short-term gold ETF gains and on the liquid-fund yield, with losses set off within the year. Indices are price indices, taxed once at exit as long-term gains. Actual results will vary with entry date, execution prices, portfolio size and the investor's tax position.

Equity investments carry risk, including loss of capital. This document is for information only and is not an offer or investment advice. Data to 30 September 2026.

3AK-CWORKS Strategy · MIP8-XL100-G3

3AK-Cworks is a fully autonomous, systematic wealth-management system: it researches, selects, trades and monitors portfolios by rule, with no emotional or discretionary calls.

Rising challengers, with gold when it leads.

MIP8-XL100-G3 is MIP8-XL100 with one addition: gold competes for a place in the portfolio on the same momentum terms as stocks. It is owned only while it leads, which in practice means the periods when Indian mid and small caps stall.

The approach

MIP8-XL100, plus gold

Buy strength

Each month the strategy ranks the NSE universe on the strength and steadiness of its price leadership.

New money goes to challengers

As in MIP8-XL100, new buying favours emerging leaders over the market's largest companies; winners keep their place.

Gold competes too

Gold is ranked on the same momentum terms as stocks and can take a limited share of the portfolio, only while it leads.

Respect the market

When conditions weaken, new buying of stocks stops and cash builds up. Gold can still be bought then, if it is leading.

Track record

Two independent tests, one consistent story

A 14-year simulation on official NSE bhavcopy data, and a separate 2021–2026 study on a different dataset. Both start from ₹10 lakh and pay full trading costs on every trade.

Strategies include about 6% a year on idle cash; indices are price indices, buy-and-hold, taxed once at exit.

Gold

Owned only while it leads

Gold is a guest, not a fixture. In the 14-year test it was held in a handful of periods and sat out the rest.

Rare

Gold led strongly enough to be owned in only a few periods since 2012. Most of the time the strongest stocks outrank it.

2025–26

The largest gain came from the precious-metals rally while Indian mid and small caps stalled; 2019–20 added a smaller amount. Excluding 2025–26 the effect was well under a point a year, and never worse than −0.7 points in a year.

Slab rate

Short-term gains on gold ETFs are taxed at the investor's income slab, not the 20% equity rate. In the tests, losses on stocks absorbed these gains each year.
